name: Celica Sylphil
source: After Celica obtains the body of the goddess, his memories are fragmented, but his basic sensibilities are comparable to what they were before he obtained it. He struggles onward against newfound hostility for the sake of his sister and Satia. With the goddess's body, he gains the ability to contract summons and utilize sexual magic.
